en:
"Help me."
He took hold of my hand.
"I've asked a lot of people for help before you.
Kazama, Iwashita, Shindo, Hosoda, Arai... I lured every one of them in with a vision of the textbook, and I talked to them.
I was testing whether they would help me.
But not one of them could do it.
That's how it always goes, huh.
They call them ghost stories and turn other people's lives into material, while they go on living without a care in the world.
Let me tell you something: you never know when misfortune's going to come crashing down on you.
Just like it did on me..."
...Who on earth is this person?
If he showed them a vision of the textbook... is he Kawahara?
When I asked, he nodded silently.
"Right now I'm testing Fukuzawa.
If she fails, I'll be testing you next."
Testing me?
What is he going to do?
"......It's no good.
Damn that Fukuzawa, she blew it.
You're next, {a}.
Please, help me.............."{p}

What is he talking about?
How am I supposed to help him?{p}

For an instant, a strong wind blew.
As if swept away by it, the darkness that had covered everything around me faded.{p}

"You collapsed all of a sudden, so I was wondering what happened."
Hosoda held out his hand.
With his help, I got to my feet.
...Was it just my imagination that I saw Kawahara a moment ago?
Then I noticed that Fukuzawa had come back.
She was slumped on the floor, completely limp.
"Um, what's wrong with Fukuzawa?"{p}

"She came back a minute ago, and then she just dropped like that."
Shindo said it as if he couldn't care less.
Fukuzawa was clutching a textbook in her hand.
"Um, that thing Fukuzawa's holding..."{p}

Could it be that what's in her hand is that textbook?
Was everyone leaving their seats earlier because this textbook was calling them?
Maybe only the people it's calling can see this textbook.
He said it was my turn next.
I picked up the textbook and opened it.
And once again, the world around me changed.{p}

......The classroom was buzzing with voices.
I didn't recognize a single face.
Which class is this?
Then I noticed a girl sitting all alone at a desk off at the edge of the room.
Someone was gossiping.
"That's her, isn't it? The girl who sent Kawahara a letter."
"They say Kawahara kept carrying around the textbook with the letter in it.
So a teacher got the wrong idea and chased him, and he ended up falling down the stairs."
"A teacher chased him?"
"You know, they said the exam questions were stolen.
Apparently he was a suspect."
"Whaaat? But why didn't he just say he didn't have them?"
"Maybe he didn't want them saying, 'Then show us that textbook'?"
"What do you mean?"
"How should I know?
Maybe he didn't want anyone to see Hashimoto's letter inside the textbook."
"You mean he was embarrassed?
What is that? That makes me so mad."
The gossiping girls went over to the girl sitting at the desk at the edge.
"You're the worst."
That was all they said, and then they walked away.
The girl they'd said it to kept her eyes on the floor.
So she's the one who sent Kawahara the love letter.
...Hashimoto, was it?
Oh, she's put her head down on the desk.
Is she crying?
After a while, she left the classroom.{p}

Hey, what about class?
Is she planning to skip it?
Call out to her
Go after her
I'll go after her.{p}
She ran off down the hallway.{p}

And then I came to the girls' restroom.
She was washing her face at the sink.
"Nooo, I'm in shock!
I really liked Kawahara, too!"
A different group of girls from the one before came into the restroom.
More gossip about Kawahara...{p}

Hashimoto fled and bumped into one of the girls.
"Eek!"
"Owww, what's your problem?"
"What's with her? She didn't even apologize."
Hashimoto ran off.
What on earth am I looking at?
Is this the world after Kawahara died?
He told me to help him, but if he brought me to the world after his own death, there's no way I can help him, is there?
...For now, I'll try following Hashimoto.
She's definitely mixed up in all this.{p}

While I was thinking that, the bell rang for class to start.
Class, huh...
I can hardly sit in on a lesson at the school from back then.
I'll stay in the hallway for a while.{p}......Still, this is boring.
I can't hang around in the hallway for almost a whole hour.
Go to the nurse's office
Go to the roof

That's it, maybe I'll go to the nurse's office.
I could pretend I'm sick and lie down on one of the beds.
I'm tired, too.
...Should I really be doing this?
But I can't do anything until class is over, so it can't be helped.{p}

When I got to the nurse's office, someone was already sleeping there.
Oh well, there are other beds... Huh?
It's Hashimoto!
So she didn't go back to the classroom after all.
She was sleeping quietly.
I wonder if she's feeling sick...{p}

As I watched her, the chime for the end of class began to ring.
I looked at the clock in the nurse's office.
At this hour, classes should be over for the day.
I wonder if Hashimoto's going straight home.{p}

The chime woke Hashimoto up.
"Hello."
"...?"
Hashimoto couldn't say a word.
She seemed frightened.
"Um, my name's {a}."
"......"
She stayed silent.
"Are you okay?
Are you feeling sick?"{p}

"......"
Hashimoto hung her head.
Ask her about Kawahara
Leave

"Hey, I wanted to ask you about Kawahara."
"......"
She sighed, still looking down.
Her face looked utterly worn out.
"I'm sorry, but this is hard for me too."
With that, Hashimoto jumped down off the bed.{p}

Hashimoto picked it up and flipped through the pages.
"Why do you have this, {a}?"
There was a letter inside the textbook.
This must be her love letter.
"Kawahara left it with me."
I answered briefly.
"......"{p}

She stood there without a word for a while, then suddenly clutched the textbook to her chest and broke into a run.
"Hey, wai..."
I hurried after her.
What's gotten into her?
She ran straight to the nearby stairs and tried to throw herself down them.
Oh no!
Is Kawahara's grudge clinging to the textbook or something?
...No way. Did he want to kill Hashimoto?{p}It's true that if she hadn't slipped that letter in, he might not have died, but...
Save Hashimoto
Watch what happens

"Look out☆"
I yanked hard on Hashimoto's hand.{p}

She lost her balance and caught herself with her hands on the stairs.
"Aaah!"
She seemed to have hit her palms hard.
She narrowed her eyes in pain.
...A tear fell from those eyes.{p}

"I just want to die."
She burst into tears.{p}What? So Hashimoto was trying to jump of her own free will?
You can't do something like that
Is something troubling you?
"You can't do something like that."{p}

"......"
She stayed silent.
Was she the one Kawahara meant when he asked me to help him?
But if the rumor that she killed herself is true, then the past can't be changed, can it?{p}...What should I do?
Try to talk her out of it
Give up
"Um, Hashimoto."{p}

"Huh? How do you know my name?"
"Well... let's just say I do.
More importantly, Kawahara was worried about you."
"That's a lie... Why would he be?"
"I met his ghost.
He asked me to help you.
So you mustn't kill yourself."
"Telling lies like that.
So you're making fun of me too.
Everyone's like that.
They spread all kinds of rumors.{p}They even write weird things on my desk, signed 'From Kawahara.'"
That's terrible...
It can't be helped
But it's not your fault
"...Even so, Kawahara died.{p}

So I'm going to die too.
And I'll curse the people who blamed me."
Is that how you really feel?
You can't do that

"Oh... yes."
Hashimoto was led away by the teacher.
The reflection room?
Could it be she's going to write that piece I read?
Then this is bad.
Hashimoto's going to kill herself today!
I have to get to the reflection room!
I went after them right away.
I pressed my ear to the reflection room door and listened to what was going on inside.{p}

Apparently she'd been called in for something that had nothing to do with Kawahara.
She was being told off about her uniform or something, and she was handing over her student handbook.
Maybe she got caught in a surprise inspection or something like that.
"Well then, write your apology letter."
With that, the teacher got up from the chair.{p}

Oh, the teacher's coming out into the hallway.
I have to hide.
I shifted to a spot where the teacher couldn't see me.
Once the teacher was gone, I slipped into the reflection room.{p}

She was writing the first line of her apology letter.
"It's my fault that Kawahara died."{p}...I knew it.
No, don't write something like that.
Tear up the apology letter
Talk her out of it

"You certainly kept us waiting long enough."
Ah, Iwashita...
Everyone else is here too.
I see, I'm back in the present again.{p}

"It's no use after all. Hashimoto killed herself."
Just then, Kawahara's voice came from somewhere.
So Hashimoto died in the end...?
"You ask other people to help you, but can't you do anything yourself, Kawahara?"
When I said that, he fell silent for a while, then murmured quietly.
"I did what I could, you know.
I wrote a message on her desk.
But it never got through to her..."
That was all he said, and then Kawahara's voice was gone.
Oh, now that I think about it...
Hashimoto said something, didn't she?
That things get written on her desk, signed 'From Kawahara.'{p}

"Ah, {b}, where are you going?"
Leaving Fukuzawa behind, I ran out of the reflection room.{p}

Hashimoto's desk.
I'll go take a look.
It was... this classroom, I'm sure.
I carefully examined the top of the desk where she'd been sitting.
There's nothing written on it.
Maybe it's already been erased.{p}

"{b}!"
Fukuzawa and the others had come after me.
"What's wrong? Oh..."
She was looking at the desk as she spoke.{p}

"This is Hashimoto's desk, isn't it?
Did you see the textbook too, {b}?
I couldn't stop her from killing herself."
She ran her finger across the top of the desk.
"People said a lot of nasty things about Hashimoto behind her back, didn't they?
You know, I saw it.
Right around here, someone had written something awful, signed 'From Kawahara.'"
"What? What did it say?"
"Well, it said 'Don't die.'"{p}

...It wasn't someone writing it out of spite.
Kawahara wrote it.
I'm sure he meant it from the heart.
Wasn't he someone who had a hard time saying what he really felt?
Those may have been words he'd thought over long and hard before he wrote them.
But they never got through to Hashimoto.
What a terrible misunderstanding.{p}

"Hey, why don't we go home now?"
At Fukuzawa's words, we left the classroom.
Everyone looked worn out.
Kawahara said it, didn't he?
That none of the people here had helped him.
In other words, they couldn't stop Hashimoto's suicide.
I don't know what each of them did when they met her.
But no matter who tried, it was bound to fail.{p}

But will Kawahara go on searching forever for someone who'll save Hashimoto?
No matter what anyone does, the past can't be undone...{p}
We went back to the reflection room and locked the door.{p}

"Hashimoto!"
I called out to her, but she left anyway.
Oh well, I guess I'll go after her.{p}
I'll go to the roof.{p}
......It's really windy today.{p}
I don't think I can stay up here very long.{p}

Oh well, I'll leave for now.
I turned to leave the nurse's office, where she lay.
"Wait!"
Just as I was about to step out into the hallway, someone suddenly called to me from behind.{p}
Startled, I dropped the textbook I was holding.{p}
"Uwaagh☆"

Hashimoto let out a dull scream and tumbled down the stairs.
...I feel sorry for her, but there's nothing I can do.
Kawahara, that's cruel.
You didn't have to go and kill this girl...
As I was thinking that, a sudden headache hit me.
What's happening to me?
My head hurts like it's splitting open.
Ah......{p}

............Darkness swallowed everything around me.
And then Kawahara appeared before my eyes once more.{p}

"What the hell are you, anyway?"
What...?
Kawahara, why would you say something like that...?
"This isn't the outcome I wanted.
Well, fine. If that's how you want it, I'll show you something good.
You're doing a feature on the school's seven wonders, right?"
He was ranting at the top of his voice.
"I'll give you some great material.
First stop, the shoe lockers.
Not that you're going home, mind you.
We're going to go see Kazama.{p}

See, right here.
The one you looked inside a little while ago.
You figured there was nothing in here, didn't you?{p}But take another look.
You're sure to find something new."
Open the shoe locker
Don't open it
The instant I opened the shoe locker, something hard and slick came tumbling out.{p}

Drops of something spattered onto my face.
A sourish smell.{p}

It was Kazama's head.
It can't be...
It was so horrible that my body wouldn't move the way I wanted.
Even so, I managed to shift my gaze, and I could see what had tumbled out of the shoe locker.
...A severed hand.
On reflex, I slammed the shoe locker shut.
The impact seemed to have jostled what was inside.{p}
Something thudded against the inside of the locker door.{p}

"He opened this door and saw the textbook.
He must've read the love letter tucked inside it, too.
What an idiot, huh? Getting all wrapped up in a letter like that, getting left behind by everyone, and ending up like this."
...What?
After Kazama stayed behind at the shoe lockers, he came back to the club room just fine, didn't he?
Why is this person saying these things?
"Let's move on."
He started walking again.
What on earth is this path?
Darkness, and a faint glimmer of light.
We aren't walking through the school, and yet we end up at places like the shoe lockers.{p}

Before I knew it, I was standing beside the cart in the old school building.
He spoke up again.{p}"Don't you think Akemi Iwashita is kind of a nasty piece of work?"
Yes, I do
No, I don't
I don't really know

"Dodging the question, huh?
Me, I figured that woman was seriously bad news."
His tone grew rougher and rougher.
"She was the type who says whatever's on her mind, wasn't she?{p}

The total opposite of me.
I didn't like her, so I fed her to the wheels.{p}

Nah, this cart's already hauling plenty of corpses as it is.
One or two more bodies won't matter. It'll carry them all the way down to hell, no problem."{p}

Long hair was caked onto the wheels.
And scraps of flesh.
I could see mushy, oozing meat, as if a scalp had been peeled off.
There was no sign of Iwashita.{p}

"Let's go."
And once again, the darkness swallowed us.{p}

The next place we came to was the gym.
The exit slammed shut with a loud bang.
"You got locked in like this earlier too, right?
Just you and Shindo, all alone.
That was me."
I could hear his voice.
But he was nowhere to be seen.
"That idiot Shindo mistook me for Tadokoro.
It was funny, so I kept my mouth shut."
He appeared and pointed at the basketball hoop.{p}

"You get it by now, right? The ones you were talking to until a little while ago were ghosts.
...I killed them."
He was grinning.
What does that mean?
Are you saying everyone was killed after they saw the textbook?
Hosoda, and Arai too...?
"You know where we're headed next, right?"
He gripped my hand hard.
"...The restroom?"
There was no answer.
He silently led me on to the next place.{p}

After walking for a while, we reached the restroom I had gone into with Hosoda today.
"That stall there... Want to take a peek?"
His back was trembling.
As if he were heaving for breath.{p}Is he laughing?
Or is he just excited?
Look in the stall
Don't look

"I've had enough.
Hosoda's been killed in here too, hasn't he? I know it."
I refused him flatly.
"Don't be like that."{p}

A hand came to rest on my shoulder from behind.
...?
A big, fleshy hand, too soft and springy to be his.
This is...{p}

"Eek...!"
A huge mass came toppling down onto me.
Hosoda★
"Ee, eek... ee...☆"
My voice wouldn't come out.
Even so, I somehow managed to dodge aside.
Hosoda collapsed limply onto the floor.
...That's not how a living person falls.{p}

"I killed this one too."
The man in front of me said it quietly.
"Are you the ghost of the man who appeared in the restroom?"
"...No."
"Then you weren't the one who possessed Hosoda in the restroom?"
"How should I know?
You all tried to turn it into newspaper material just for kicks, so some ghost or other got angry, I guess."{p}
He took my hand and led me off again.{p}

...The next place we came to was the audiovisual room.
On a desk near the entrance lay a single 8mm tape.
"Arai's dead inside this thing.
He told you, didn't he? That next it was your turn to be killed by this video.{p}I wonder if that'll really happen?"
I suppose it will
Don't joke about this!
Please, help me
Not a chance.{p}

You couldn't save Hashimoto.
Worse than that, you just stood there in silence and watched her try to kill herself.
Kazama, Iwashita, Shindo, Hosoda, Arai, Fukuzawa... they were all the same.
They treat other people's suffering like it's none of their business.
That's why I killed them.
I wanted them to taste the same pain. The pain called death.
This is to make an example of them.
I killed them.
Right on the stages of the ghost stories they told.
What's the matter?
You're shaking.{p}

Hm hm, I'll kill you too.
Together with Fukuzawa, in the reflection room.
Or would you rather follow Arai?
You were supposed to be killed by the Mummy Man in the video, weren't you?
Hahahahaha, hahahahahaha..............{p}

For an instant, a strong wind blew.
As if swept away by it, the darkness that had covered everything around me faded.{p}

And I was back in the reflection room.
Kazama and the others were already gone.
Had they really been killed?
...There was a raw, fishy smell.
Like a fish that had been gutted.
No, a nastier smell than that.
Come to think of it, I'd heard that cutting open a human belly makes a horrible stink.
That's why medical students nearly faint during surgery practice and such...
Thinking about things like that, I turned around.{p}

...It's Fukuzawa.
She had collapsed, slumped against the wall.
Her face and body were drenched in blood.
It was hard to tell with all the blood soaking her uniform, but judging by this smell, her belly must have been split wide open.{p}The next instant, the shelf lurched and tipped over.{p}
My head sent up a spray of blood even bigger than Fukuzawa's belly had...{p}

"No, you don't. You're going to look inside."
The moment he said it, an invisible force moved my hand and opened the shoe locker door.{p}
That instant, something hard and slick came tumbling out.{p}

"Right?
She seems like the type who says whatever's on her mind, doesn't she?{p}

"I see.
Doesn't matter what you think.
I didn't like her from the moment I first laid eyes on her.
She seems like the type who says whatever's on her mind, doesn't she?{p}

"Naive."
It was Kawahara's voice.{p}
That's right, this is no joke.{p}
"Hashimoto, if something's troubling you, tell me."{p}

...There's surely nothing I can do.
What's already happened can't be undone anyway.
This is between the two of them.
"Sorry for bothering you."
I left.{p}
And then the darkness closed in all around.{p}

...When I came to, I was standing in the reflection room.
The people who had told me about the seven wonders were gone.
What day is it today?
For now, I decided to go back to the club room.
If I'm back on the day of the seven wonders meeting, the club room should be set up for it.{p}

Through the windows along the hallway, I could see the dark sky.
What a horrible night.{p}

...When I got back to the club room, Hino was there.
"Hino?"
"{a}?
What happened to you?
That was low, skipping out on the seven wonders meeting."
"What?"
"You didn't show, so the members I gathered griped at me.
I had to run the meeting myself in your place, you know."
"But... I heard stories from six people."
"Don't lie to me.
Or what, did a tanuki play a trick on you?"
Then what on earth were the stories I heard?
And those six people?
"Hino, the members you gathered..."
"All third-years, from my class.
Let's see, Hongo, Mori, Tanaka, Hayashi..."
Every one of them was a name I didn't know.
If what Hino said was true, then what on earth had I been seeing?{p}

I went back to the reflection room once more.
"...Oh."
My watch was lying in a corner of the reflection room floor.
It's the one I dropped while trying to tidy up the club room before Fukuzawa told her story.
Could it be that while I thought I was in the club room, I had really been summoned to this reflection room?
Was it all set up by Kawahara?
Kazama, Iwashita, Shindo, Hosoda, Arai, Fukuzawa...
Were they all illusions Kawahara showed me?
Or maybe they, too, were people who had died for some reason.{p}

I went back to the newspaper club room again.
I really have to write this feature myself.
I told Hino how Kawahara's power had drawn me into the reflection room and how I'd been through something strange.
And somehow I talked him around, and it was decided that I would see this project through to the end.{p}
The next day, I went to the reflection room.{p}

"It can't be helped anymore.
Kawahara's dead, after all.{p}

"That's right.
Kawahara's dead, after all.{p}

"Why are you giving me orders?
Don't act so high and mighty.{p}

Anyway, I did something terrible to Kawahara.
So I don't deserve to live."{p}

"Hashimoto, stop!"
I shouted before I could stop myself.
But she wouldn't stop writing.
"Hashimoto!"
Can't my voice reach her?
The moment I tried to go to her, I was engulfed in a blinding light.{p}
